svg.title: The $690,000 Base-Case Waterfall
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-03-base-case-contribution-waterfall; chart type: waterfall; title: The $690,000 Base-Case Waterfall; subtitle: $379,500 retained contribution becomes $144,900 owner profit after operator expenses.; chapter number: 3; epistemic tag: illustrative_model; assumptions note: All amounts are annual USD. Bars 1, 3, and 6 are absolute totals or subtotals; bars 2, 4, and 5 are signed deductions. Subtotals must reset the plotted running balance rather than being added again. The $180,000 and $54,600 expense categories are illustrative allocations of the canonical $234,600 residual operator expense requirement, not separately supplied estimates.; caption: $690,000 - $310,500 = $379,500; $379,500 - $180,000 - $54,600 = $144,900. Owner profit equals 21.0% of gross billings and 38.18% of retained contribution. Apply the supplied 55% ASC 606 net-presentation convention; actual principal-versus-agent presentation follows the contracts and control analysis.; stages: label: Gross operator billings; value: $690,000 annual lease, dispatch, and co-hosting charges; numeric value: 690000.0; detail: Opening total: $57,500 average monthly gross billings. Exclude underlying passenger fares, vehicle purchase values, refundable deposits, and investor capital from this operator billing measure.; label: Owner splits and pass-through costs; value: Subtract $310,500 distributed or passed through under contracts; numeric value: -310500.0; detail: Deduction: 45% of gross billings leaves the operator under the canonical retained-share model. Reconcile owner distributions and pass-through fleet costs individually; do not deduct these same costs again below retained contribution.; label: Retained contribution subtotal; value: $379,500 remains under the supplied 55% retained-share convention; numeric value: 379500.0; detail: Absolute subtotal: $31,625 average monthly retained contribution. This is the supplied net-presentation revenue basis, not owner profit and not a separate increment added to the running balance.; label: Recurring operator operating costs; value: Subtract $180,000 for the modeled recurring operating cost envelope; numeric value: -180000.0; detail: Deduction: $15,000 monthly covers the modeled operator labor, contractor support, software, administration, and operator-borne recurring costs. Include only costs outside the preceding owner and pass-through deduction.; label: Depreciation and uninsured collision expense; value: Subtract $54,600 in separately modeled operator-borne expense; numeric value: -54600.0; detail: Deduction: $4,550 monthly equivalent represents recognized depreciation where the operator bears it and uninsured collision expense. Investor-borne depreciation stays with the investor; cash transferred into a reserve is not itself expense.; label: Annual owner profit total; value: $144,900 equals 21.0% of gross operator billings; numeric value: 144900.0; detail: Closing total: $12,075 monthly equivalent and 38.18% of $379,500 retained contribution. Preserve the scorecard owner-profit definition; this figure is not a statement of after-personal-tax distributions or unrestricted cash.

rect.title: label: Gross operator billings; value: $690,000 annual lease, dispatch, and co-hosting charges; numeric value: 690000.0; detail: Opening total: $57,500 average monthly gross billings. Exclude underlying passenger fares, vehicle purchase values, refundable deposits, and investor capital from this operator billing measure.

label: Owner splits and pass-through costs; value: Subtract $310,500 distributed or passed through under contracts; numeric value: -310500.0; detail: Deduction: 45% of gross billings leaves the operator under the canonical retained-share model. Reconcile owner distributions and pass-through fleet costs individually; do not deduct these same costs again below retained contribution.

label: Retained contribution subtotal; value: $379,500 remains under the supplied 55% retained-share convention; numeric value: 379500.0; detail: Absolute subtotal: $31,625 average monthly retained contribution. This is the supplied net-presentation revenue basis, not owner profit and not a separate increment added to the running balance.

label: Recurring operator operating costs; value: Subtract $180,000 for the modeled recurring operating cost envelope; numeric value: -180000.0; detail: Deduction: $15,000 monthly covers the modeled operator labor, contractor support, software, administration, and operator-borne recurring costs. Include only costs outside the preceding owner and pass-through deduction.

label: Depreciation and uninsured collision expense; value: Subtract $54,600 in separately modeled operator-borne expense; numeric value: -54600.0; detail: Deduction: $4,550 monthly equivalent represents recognized depreciation where the operator bears it and uninsured collision expense. Investor-borne depreciation stays with the investor; cash transferred into a reserve is not itself expense.

label: Annual owner profit total; value: $144,900 equals 21.0% of gross operator billings; numeric value: 144900.0; detail: Closing total: $12,075 monthly equivalent and 38.18% of $379,500 retained contribution. Preserve the scorecard owner-profit definition; this figure is not a statement of after-personal-tax distributions or unrestricted cash.
